name: feed_reader
title: Feed reader: single-vertex reads
expect: Condensed props + Split/Condensed adjacency (Condensed/Split or All-Condensed); Chunked pays a chunk per read
why: each query reads one vertex or one friend list. Condensed properties read a vertex in one GET, where Split pays one GET per property (7 for a Person). A friend list costs 2 SEEKs in Condensed (one per direction) and Split adds one NEXT per friend (the anchors average ~{friends} friends). Chunked reads a whole 64 KB chunk to get one vertex: about the same ops, {chunk_x} the bytes.

why_scale_free.2: knows is declared in both directions (schema): one list each
